## The defect, as PR #19438 states it

`check-widening-tells.mjs`'s **T2** doctrine names four closed-set forms — `z.enum([…])`, `z.union([…])`, `z.discriminatedUnion(…)`, and a `CORE_PLUGIN_TYPES`-shaped `as const` array. The classifier required **none** of them: a lone quoted string, or a bare `…Schema,` arm, anywhere on the contract-source surface was routed to T2, and the row then rendered 「a new member of a closed set … the accept set gains a value」 over it.

⭐ That is a fact the instrument never measured. It is ⛔ **not** covered by the file's own 「a tell, never a proof」 allowance, which excuses a tell that is right about its own shape and silent about direction — this one is wrong about its own shape.

⚠️ The card's line anchors drifted three times, each re-read from source rather than adjusted by arithmetic: `BARE_STRING_ELEMENT` `:1962` → `:1957` → `:2111`; the `memberTellKind` arm routing to T2 `:3373` → `:3368` → `:3644`. The drift is `d9282a4bd7` (#19153, +337/−27 in that file), which landed the T1 leg.

## Disposition — ruled, ⛔ not this seat's judgment

The director seat's pointer on the original card (`5755286648`, 2026-09-21T04:13Z) records **ruling #208 on #19491**, maintainer 「19491 接受你的建议，并立刻派发处理相关任务。」:

> ruling #208 on #19491 … makes `check-widening-tells` report-only and stops its development; the other four false-positive cards (#19341, #19221, #19440, #17926) are closed `not_planned` in this stroke. This card and PR #19438 carry the spec seat's claim and assignee, so this seat does not touch them: the spec seat closes both under the same ruling … or says on this card why not.

⇒ this rebuild exists so that disposition has a carrier it can actually be written on. **This card is closed `not_planned` in the same stroke as its creation**, and PR #19438 is closed with it — the work stopped at round 8 and that is already on this seat's record.

⛔ Not closed because the finding is wrong. The defect is real and was measured across eight rounds; what the ruling settles is that a **report-only** instrument does not earn dev time for being wrong. If `check-widening-tells` is ever made to hold a hard gate again, this card is the record of what T2 does not measure.
